callouts.label: Wash Hands First
callouts.hint: Hands lather with soap under running water at the left sink.
callouts.description: Clean hands keep germs from moving onto ingredients and tools.
callouts.tip: Wash before touching food and again after handling raw foods.

callouts.label: Rinse Produce
callouts.hint: Fresh fruits and vegetables rinse in clean running water.
callouts.description: Rinsing removes soil and some germs before food is cut or eaten.
callouts.tip: Use clean water and keep produce away from raw meat.

callouts.label: Separate Raw Food
callouts.hint: Raw poultry stays on its own red cutting board.
callouts.description: Raw meat can carry germs that should not reach ready-to-eat food.
callouts.tip: Use a dedicated board and clean it carefully afterward.

callouts.label: Separate Produce Board
callouts.hint: Vegetables are cut on a different green board with a separate knife.
callouts.tip: Never reuse a raw-meat plate for cooked food.

callouts.label: Cook Thoroughly
callouts.hint: An adult cooks food fully in a steaming pan.
callouts.description: Thorough cooking destroys many harmful germs.
callouts.tip: A trusted adult handles hot pans and checks doneness.

callouts.label: Use a Clean Plate
callouts.hint: Cooked food rests on a clean white plate.
callouts.description: Cooked food stays safer when it never returns to a raw-food plate.

callouts.label: Cool in Shallow Containers
callouts.hint: Cooked leftovers sit in several shallow covered containers.
callouts.description: Shallow containers help leftovers cool more evenly before refrigerator storage.
callouts.tip: Put leftovers away promptly with adult help.

callouts.label: Store Safely in the Refrigerator
callouts.hint: A refrigerator keeps sealed raw foods low and ready-to-eat foods above.
callouts.description: Cold storage slows germ growth, and sealed lower-shelf raw foods reduce drips.

callouts.label: Pack with an Ice Pack
callouts.hint: An insulated lunchbox holds chilled food beside a blue ice pack.
callouts.description: Cold foods need to stay cold on the way to lunch.
callouts.tip: An insulated bag and ice pack help maintain a safer temperature.

callouts.label: Pack Clean Utensils and Water
callouts.hint: A clean bottle and utensil case wait beside the lunchbox.
callouts.description: Clean reusable items prevent yesterday’s food and germs from returning.
callouts.tip: Wash and dry reusable containers between uses.

callouts.label: Wash Before Eating
callouts.hint: A child washes hands at a second sink before lunch.
callouts.description: Clean hands protect the food at the final step before eating.
callouts.tip: Use soap even when hands look clean.

callouts.label: Ask About Questionable Food
callouts.hint: A child eats from a clean lunch container while an adult is nearby to help.
callouts.description: Food that smells strange, looks spoiled, or was stored unsafely should not be tasted.
callouts.tip: Keep it closed and ask a trusted adult.
